final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS matched_count FROM film_actor AS fa JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(matched_count) AS average_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(rc.matched_count) AS total_count, AVG(rc.matched_count - ra.average_count) AS average_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra WHERE ra.average_count IS NOT NULL AND rc.matched_count > ra.average_count
